speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To help me diagnose this, can you tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when your symptoms started?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection).

The sudden onset of fever, headache, and malaise at 30 weeks gestation, specifically following the consumption of unpasteurized dairy products (ice cream), is highly characteristic of Listeriosis. I will request blood cultures to confirm the diagnosis.
